# Contextual carrier transfers

Owned inputs retain a carrier subtype bounded by an independently scoped element formal, one fixed context and an invariant class token. Frozen direct, compiled, reflection and MethodHandle callers compare raw and checked consumers, original/alternate/null objects, context and token identity, callback mutations, class initialization, exact checked/unchecked failures and delayed casts. Source and SDK profiles compile every output and preserve original method roles, Signature and Exceptions. Only owned classes execute.
